name: Radio Astronomy & Pulsars
summary: The group studies pulsars and other compact radio sources through precision timing, propagation measurements, and radio observations.

name: Transients & Multi-Messenger Astronomy
summary: The group investigates short-lived and variable events using electromagnetic, gravitational-wave, and multi-messenger observations.

name: Galaxies & Cosmology
summary: The group explores how galaxies form and evolve, how matter is distributed, and what large surveys reveal about cosmic history.

name: Gravitational Waves & Relativity
summary: The group develops theory, models, and data-analysis methods for gravitational-wave sources and tests of relativistic gravity.

name: Stars, Planets & Star Formation
summary: The group studies stellar and planetary systems from their formation through later evolution using observations and physical modelling.

name: Data, Software & Research Methods
summary: The group advances astronomical data analysis, research software, statistics, archives, and reproducible scientific workflows.
